notes: Default options, recorded as not passing: attributes are dropped, so the stock count is wrong, and price comes back as a bare number, so the #text read gives NaN. See the attributes variant.
details: Default options. Parses to a plain object and the adapter reads the product fields from it. By default attributes are dropped, so the stock attribute is never seen and the in-stock count is wrong, and price (which has a currency attribute) comes back as a bare number so the adapter's #text read gives NaN; recorded as not passing. See the attributes variant.
